aiVerification.summary: Draft is not safe as final evidence because the changed factor and measurement groupings are materially misidentified.
issues: Changed factor is the filename, not the compared conditions.
Baseline/test conditions are left unclear despite OK vs NG sample context.
Parsed measurement stats mix row labels, sample numbers, and values.
Outcome domains should separate vision, coil A-B dimension, and coil offset frame.
Conclusion and decision rows are not used as evidence.
correctionPlan: Set factor to sample condition: OK vs NG noise and NG touch.
Use Sample OK as comparator and NG noise/NG touch as abnormal groups.
Regroup outcomes by the three report sections and retain date/line/type context.
Re-extract numeric tables from actual data rows and remove label-derived stats.
Cite section headers, data rows, conclusion row, and decision row.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are insufficient and misgrouped for final evidence.
